decisions.reason: The battery-runtime goal constrains power-path efficiency but does not change the established overcharge, overdischarge, or electrical-protection requirements.
Maximizing battery runtime does not alter the required NTC connection or AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
The source decision does not change the AXP2101 exposed-pad heat-transfer requirement.
The battery-efficiency goal does not resolve or modify the battery connector family, pin count, functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not change the charge-status display or dedicated charge-LED interface.
The battery-runtime objective does not modify the panel power button, its connector, or its PWRON control behavior.
The existing switchable, normally-off 5V rail already remains valid; the source supplies no new boost-control value, load policy, or efficiency parameter.
The general battery-efficiency goal does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, load coverage, or Schottky-drop compensation.
The source does not change which rails are monitored, the monitor device, measurement placement, coverage, or channel allocation.
The battery-efficiency constraint concerns normal battery-powered operation and does not alter the standalone USB supply path or its source-selection behavior.
The source decision has no necessary effect on connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or integrated-board connector removal.
The battery-runtime goal does not modify the panel-control connector inventory, signal assignments, or on-board button policy.
